title: Harissa prawns with greens
summary: Harissa prawns with greens is a middle eastern dinner built around raw king prawns and rose harissa paste, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Harissa prawns with greens chopped before the pan goes on. Pat raw king prawns dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook raw king prawns until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook rose harissa paste and baby spinach until hot and lightly browned. Return raw king prawns and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Harissa prawns with greens, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Harissa prawns with greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
